resourceName: Guizhou Xingren IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Guizhou Xingren  IFM (conversion of logged to protected  forest) Project (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Xingren City, Qianxinan Buyi and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province of China by Xingren Lishuping State-owned Forest Farm, the geo-coordinate of the  project proponent is 104°54′E -105°34′E and 25°18'N - 25°47'N, the total area is 178530 ha, which includes the Improved Forest Management (IFM) of the forests in the conversion of logged to protected forest.
The area of the project activity is 4666.58 ha, including 1486 subcompartments spreading over Baling Town, Baide Town, Boyang Town, Dashan Town, Huilong Town, Mamaya Town, Panjiazhuang Town, Tunjiao Town, Xiashan Town, Xinlongchang Town, Yuzhang Town, Chengbei Street office, Chengnan Street office, Donghu Street office, Zhenwushan Street office, Fangmaping Pasture, Lishuping State-owned forest farm,
Qingshuihe Natural Reserve of Guizhou Xingren . All these forests are state-owned forests or privately-owned or collective-owned, and have the legal right to forest ownership. The species involved in the project are Broadleaf Mix and Chinese Fir.
Before the implementation of the project activity, the trees are logged based on a valid and verifiable government-approved timber management plan for harvesting the project area. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 370,878 tCO2e in 20 years, the average annual emission reduction is 18,544 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 341,207 tCO2e in 20 years, and average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 17,060 tCO2e.
The project activity will contribute to the environment (biodiversity conservation, rocky desertification prevention and soil erosion control), thus contribute to sustainable development.
